    "ebpmtrciaacli", "iapcbrmiasclet"
]

def get_anagrams(target):
    target_lower = target.lower()
    target_counter = Counter(target_lower)
    matches = []
    for word in words:
        if len(word) == len(target) and Counter(word.lower()) == target_counter:
            matches.append(word)
    return matches

results = {}
for word in scrambled:
